statement.summary: Corollary 7.2 is frozen as `corDensStatement` = `densityStatement` ∧ `densityClosedStatement`. The density-uniform distribution is the literal two-stage mathlib PMF `densPMF` (uniform k ∈ Fin (N+1), then uniform on C^a_k, composed by `PMF.bind`). P^dens is `probDens`, the PMF's measure of S_{n^d} as a real. The first Prop is the displayed formula with |S^a_{n^d,k}| = `numKActive`; the second substitutes Theorem 5.1's `kActiveRHS`.
deltas: Alphabet Σ = `Fin σ`; the fixed state a is universally quantified (a : Fin σ).
The distribution is the mathlib PMF `densPMF` (uniform on Fin (N+1), then `PMF.uniformOfFinset` on C^a_k, by `PMF.bind`); its nonemptiness proof `configsWithK_nonempty` uses σ ≥ 2.
P^dens = `probDens` = (outer measure of {s | IsShiftSymmetric s} under `densPMF`).toReal.
Standing hypotheses n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1 from Definition 2.1 are explicit (d ≥ 1 is unused by the proof); `NeZero n` is built from n ≥ 2 inside the statement.
All arithmetic in ℝ; C(N,k) is `Nat.choose` cast to ℝ; σ − 1 in ℝ; N − k is ℕ-subtraction, exact for k ≤ N; Σ_{k=0}^N is `Finset.range (N+1)`.
'with |S^a_{n^d,k}| given by Theorem 5.1' is a separate Prop with `kActiveRHS` (Theorem 5.1's right side, ℤ cast to ℝ) in place of `numKActive`.

maps.label: Corollary 7.2 = displayed formula ∧ closed form
maps.note: The corollary is split into the displayed formula (`densityStatement`) and the same formula with Theorem 5.1's right side substituted (`densityClosedStatement`).

maps.label: σ ≥ 2
maps.note: The corollary's own hypothesis. It is a named binder because the distribution needs it to be well defined: every set C^a_k is nonempty (`configsWithK_nonempty`).

maps.label: standing n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1
maps.note: From Definition 2.1. `hn` is named because it builds the `NeZero n` instance (finite configuration space). `1 ≤ d` is not used by the proof.

maps.label: the fixed state a (∀ a)
maps.note: The paper fixes a ∈ Σ in the §5 preamble, and P^dens depends on a only through the notation. Lean quantifies over every a : Fin σ, so the claim holds for each a.

maps.label: the density-uniform distribution (two stages)
maps.note: A mathlib `PMF` on configurations, built as a `PMF.bind` of the two stages below.

maps.label: first draw k ∈ {0,…,N} uniformly
maps.note: Uniform on `Fin (N+1)` = {0,…,N}.

maps.label: then a configuration with exactly k cells in state a, uniformly

tex.text: then a configuration with exactly $k$ cells in state $a$ uniformly

lean.text: PMF.uniformOfFinset (configsWithK n d σ a k)
Finset.univ.filter fun s => cellsInState s a = k
Nat.card {u : Lat n d // s u = a}

maps.note: Uniform on the finset C^a_k of configurations with exactly k cells in state a, composed with the first stage by `.bind`.

maps.label: C^a_k ≠ ∅ for σ ≥ 2 (well-definedness)
maps.note: `PMF.uniformOfFinset` needs a nonempty finset, and this proof is part of the definition. It is where σ ≥ 2 enters the definition.

maps.label: probability that the drawn configuration lies in S_{n^d}

tex.text: the probability that the drawn configuration lies in $S_{n^d}$

lean.text: ((densPMF n d σ hσ a).toOuterMeasure {s | IsShiftSymmetric s}).toReal

maps.note: P^dens = the PMF's (outer) measure of S_{n^d} = {s | IsShiftSymmetric s}, converted to ℝ by `toReal`. The conversion is faithful because a PMF's mass is ≤ 1.

maps.label: P^dens = (1/(N+1)) Σ_k |S^a_{n^d,k}| / (C(N,k)(σ−1)^{N−k})

lean.text: probDens n d σ hσ a = (1 / ((n ^ d : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n ^ d + 1), (numKActive n d σ a k : ℝ) / (((n ^ d).choose k : ℝ) * ((σ : ℝ) - 1) ^ (n ^ d - k))

maps.note: Equality of real numbers.

maps.label: P^dens_{n^d}

lean.text: probDens n d σ hσ a

maps.note: `probDens`, the probability defined above; it also depends on a and on the proof hσ.

maps.label: 1/(N+1)
maps.note: Real division, N = n^d.

maps.label: Σ_{k=0}^{N}
maps.note: `Finset.range (N+1)` = {0,…,N}.

maps.label: |S^a_{n^d,k}|

tex.text: let $S^a_{n^d,k}$ be the set of shift-symmetric configurations with exactly $k$ cells in state $a$

lean.text: (numKActive n d σ a k : ℝ)
Nat.card {s : Config n d (Fin σ) // IsShiftSymmetric s ∧ cellsInState s a = k}

maps.note: `numKActive`: `Nat.card` of the shift-symmetric configurations with exactly k cells in state a, cast to ℝ.

maps.label: C(N,k)(σ−1)^{N−k}

lean.text: ((n ^ d).choose k : ℝ) * ((σ : ℝ) - 1) ^ (n ^ d - k)

maps.note: = |C^a_k| (proved in the certificate). It is a positive integer for σ ≥ 2 and 0 ≤ k ≤ N, so the real division never meets x/0 = 0.

maps.label: C(N,k)
maps.note: The ordinary `Nat.choose` (k ≤ N on the summation range, so the §5 convention with h = 1 is never invoked), cast to ℝ.

maps.label: (σ−1)^{N−k}
maps.note: σ − 1 is computed in ℝ (no truncated subtraction). N − k is ℕ-subtraction, exact since k ≤ N.

maps.label: N = n^d
maps.note: N is written out as n^d everywhere.

maps.label: with |S^a_{n^d,k}| given by Theorem 5.1

lean.text: ∑ v ∈ (rankVectors n d).erase 0, kActiveSummand n d σ k v

maps.note: The same formula with |S^a_{n^d,k}| replaced by Theorem 5.1's right side `kActiveRHS` (the ℤ-valued alternating sum, cast to ℝ). The certificate substitutes the core Theorem 5.1 (`numKActive_eq_rhs`).

maps.label: alphabet Σ = Fin σ
maps.note: Only |Σ| = σ enters.

maps.label: NeZero n built inside the statement
maps.note: Technical: makes `Lat n d` a `Fintype`, so the uniform distributions exist. It is derived from n ≥ 2, so nothing is assumed.
